label: Indirect or accidental preservation: Preservation by removing a cause of corruption, illustrated…
definition: Preservation by removing a cause of corruption, illustrated by guarding a child from fire in q.104 a.1. It does not itself make the guardian a direct giver or cause of the child's esse.
note: Declaration-completion investigation (2026-11-09): TruthCore.Causality.PreservationCandidates.InterceptionCandidate is an incomplete analyst action/target/threat candidate, not this sourced definition. Interception carries a threat with source and target, and requires an ongoing episode directed at that target. Controls reject a threat to a different bearer and separate interception from productive contribution. The concrete removeThreat candidate implements set subtraction: the addressed represented threat disappears while other threats survive, including another threat to the same bearer. OPEN formal content: deletion of a threat record does not establish that an action stops the represented corruption process. Interception does not yet imply successful prevention, and prevention of one threat does not imply complete protection or continued existence. To complete the original meaning requires process/outcome semantics connecting the intervention to cessation of an actual corrupting process, without identifying protection with esse-giving. No original sense allowance is removed; no arbitrary modal-power interpretation or CausesIn bridge is asserted. Source acquisition is deferred; the candidate is analyst stipulation only. Process-transition follow-up: TruthCore.Causality.ProtectiveProcess now defines terminal process occurrence (occurs ∧ terminal ∧ same target), admissible intervention histories, explicit represented-loss coverage, no-bypass and sampled ProtectedInterval. Safety is proved by history induction under those explicit conditions. The finite populated flame history has ready→burning→lost, while a guarded history with the same initial state interrupts the first edge and remains safe. Other actual histories witness direct bypass and safe→lost replacement. Label deletion, wrong-bearer removal, and omissions of admissibility, loss coverage or initial presence do not protect. RealizesInterception is a separate OPEN transition-realization premise; its projection to the old candidate is marked transcription. This supplies a positive bounded analyst process candidate, NOT a faithful completion of the whole sourced meaning: actual physical realization, continuous-interval coverage and the original action/process interpretation remain open. Both original preservation allowances remain. Root connection plan: STMT-PARTICIPATED-ESSE-HAS-DISTINCT-CAUSE (732302a1-f7bf-594d-9a8a-cb4bd00687a7) actually reaches the Catholicism root and is consumed by Round2Grounding.contingentGroundedViaParticipation. Its type requires ∀x, Participates x → ∃c, c≠x ∧ CausesIn c x esse. A safeguarded history supplies no such productive esse edge: the control retains realized protection with every CausesIn edge absent. Next missing inference is a separately defined positive productive receipt/dependence of this same bearer, calibrated to CausesIn at esse; protective success is not that calibration. Participation and its cause requirement remain open inputs. The existing ActualEsseCausesSupportAt can only map already-given present distinct esse causes to support and currently has no root-reaching direct consumer; it cannot supply the missing cause. No whole-conclusion bridge is proposed, no case progress or root discharge is claimed, and no narrower temporal mechanism is identified with timeless divine conservation.
